entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this helmet. Right now. This whole process is a joke and I'm not happy.
I can certainly look into that for you, and I'm sorry to hear you're frustrated. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference issue?
The issue is the color is hideous! It looks nothing like it did online. I haven't even bothered to take it out of the packaging, the box is unopened. I want my money back. Is that clear enough?
Yes, thank you for clarifying. I completely understand that getting the wrong color can be disappointing. Can I get your order number, please?
It's VF-8675309. Look, are you going to help me or do I need to speak to a manager? I swear I will light you up on every review site if this becomes difficult.
That won't be necessary, sir. I'm pulling up your order now. I see you purchased the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered nine days ago. I can absolutely process this return for you.
So you're just going to take it back? Just like that? What's the catch?

There's no catch at all. You're unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy for standard gear. Your satisfaction and safety are our top priorities, and that includes being happy with your equipment. Since the box is unopened, it's a very simple process.
Fine. So what do I do?

I am generating a pre-paid return label and emailing it to you as we speak. You should have it in your inbox in the next minute or so. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any shipping center. Once we receive the helmet, you'll see a full refund within 3-5 business days.
Okay. I see the email. Alright, fine.
Excellent. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Great. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can get you into a color you prefer next time. Have a good day.
